source.name: Jabatan Warisan Negara — Pengisytiharan Warisan Kebangsaan
source.nameEn: Department of National Heritage — National Heritage declarations
source.licence: Official gazette lists are government publications; coordinates relocated via OpenStreetMap (ODbL).
source.coordinateNote: This is a small honest WP Kuala Lumpur register built from the 2007, 2009 and 2012 National Heritage lists plus named OSM landmarks. It is not the Fine Arts Department's 571 Bangkok monuments. Sites the OSM name-match could not place stay at district precision and are never pinned.

sites.name: Bangunan Sultan Abdul Samad
sites.history: Civic range of the Federated Malay States, 1894–1897, facing Dataran Merdeka. Gazetted National Heritage in 2007; the 10 May 2012 gazetting ceremony was held here.
sites.present: Still the postcard of colonial Kuala Lumpur: copper onion domes and a clock tower on the padang.

sites.name: Masjid Jamek Kuala Lumpur
sites.history: A. B. Hubback, 1909, at the confluence of Sungai Klang and Sungai Gombak — the founding water of Kuala Lumpur. National Heritage 2009.
sites.present: Onion domes at the two-river confluence; the River of Life terraces wrap the south bank.

sites.name: Masjid Negara dan Makam Pahlawan
sites.history: National Mosque, 1965. Folded 16-point umbrella roof and a 73 m minaret. Gazetted with Makam Pahlawan in 2007.
sites.present: The modernist mosque of independent Malaya, still in daily use.

sites.name: Bangunan Parlimen Malaysia
sites.history: Parliament House, opened 1963. National Heritage 2007.
sites.present: The federal legislature's hilltop compound west of the lake gardens.

sites.name: Tugu Negara
sites.history: National Monument, Felix de Weldon, dedicated 1966. National Heritage 2007.
sites.present: Bronze group above the lake gardens; a working memorial, not a skyline prop.

sites.name: Bangunan Ibu Stesen Keretapi
sites.history: Kuala Lumpur Railway Station, A. B. Hubback, 1910. The heritage listing is Bangunan Ibu Stesen Keretapi. OSM currently names the public-transport station polygon KA02; the pin is that polygon's centroid, recorded as a fuzzy name match.
sites.present: Mughal-revival station still in KTM use, facing the old Majestic.

sites.name: Carcosa Seri Negara
sites.history: Residence of the British Resident-General, 1896–1897. National Heritage 2007.
sites.present: Two colonial houses in the lake gardens; currently closed as a hotel.

sites.name: Dewan Bandaraya Kuala Lumpur
sites.history: City Hall, north of Dataran Merdeka. National Heritage 2007.
sites.present: DBKL's historic civic building on the padang.

sites.name: Stadium Merdeka
sites.history: Where Tunku Abdul Rahman declared Merdeka on 31 August 1957. National Heritage 2009. Now in the shadow of Merdeka 118.
sites.present: Restored bowl next to the 678.9 m tower.

sites.name: Victoria Institution
sites.history: Boys' school founded 1893; present building 1929. National Heritage 2009.
sites.present: Still a working school. OSM campus polygon is large; the pin is its centroid.

sites.name: Istana Negara (Jalan Istana)
sites.history: The old National Palace on Jalan Istana, gazetted 2007. OSM currently labels several Istana Negara polygons, including the 2011 Jalan Duta palace. This twin does not pick among them.
sites.present: Not pinned. District precision only — the wrong palace would be a worse map than no pin.

sites.name: Bangunan Bekas JKR Selangor
sites.history: Former Selangor Public Works Department building, National Heritage 2007. No OSM name match was accepted for this pass.
sites.present: Unlocated. Listed so the register does not pretend the 2007 gazette is fully pinned.

sites.name: Pejabat Pos Besar Kuala Lumpur
sites.history: General Post Office, National Heritage 2007. Not pinned in this pass — the Dataran Merdeka civic group is dense and a wrong GPO pin would collide with Sultan Abdul Samad.
sites.present: Unlocated pending a named OSM way that is not the neighbouring civic range.

sites.name: Dewan Perhimpunan Cina Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor
sites.history: Chinese Assembly Hall of Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. National Heritage 2007. No exact OSM name match accepted.
sites.present: Unlocated.

sites.name: Thean Hou Temple / 天后宫
sites.registerStatus: Tidak tersenarai Warisan Kebangsaan (senarai 2007/2009/2012 yang disemak)
sites.history: Hillside Chinese temple, 1980s, dedicated to Mazu. Iconic; not found on the 2007/2009/2012 National Heritage lists pulled for this twin.
sites.present: Six-tier temple above the highway. Identity from OSM; not a JWN gazette.

sites.name: Sri Maha Mariamman Temple
sites.registerStatus: Tidak tersenarai Warisan Kebangsaan (senarai 2007/2009/2012 yang disemak)
sites.history: Oldest Hindu temple in Kuala Lumpur, 1873, on the edge of Petaling Street. Not on the JWN lists pulled here.
sites.present: Gopuram on Jalan Tun H.S. Lee; the silver chariot for Thaipusam leaves from here.

sites.name: Menara Berkembar Petronas
sites.registerStatus: Bukan tapak Warisan Kebangsaan — menara komersial
sites.history: 1998, Cesar Pelli. CTBUH architectural height 451.9 m; occupied 375 m; skybridge 58.4 m at 170 m AGL.
sites.present: Still the city's pair of towers. OSM records them as one combined way.

sites.name: Menara Merdeka Maybank
sites.registerStatus: Bukan tapak Warisan Kebangsaan — menara komersial
sites.history: CTBUH architectural height 678.9 m, occupied 502.8 m, 118 floors. Next to Stadium Merdeka.
sites.present: The spire that now owns the skyline south of the padang.

sites.name: Menara Kuala Lumpur
sites.registerStatus: Bukan tapak Warisan Kebangsaan — menara pemerhatian
sites.history: Observation tower. Published antenna 421 m, pod roof 336.5 m, observatory 276 m. OSM has a node, no building way.
sites.present: Pink-pod shaft on Bukit Nanas, between the colonial core and KLCC.

sites.name: Menara Exchange 106
sites.registerStatus: Bukan tapak Warisan Kebangsaan — menara komersial
sites.history: CTBUH architectural height 453.6 m, 95 floors. Some Chinese-language summaries quote 445.5 m; this register follows CTBUH.
sites.present: The TRX centrepiece east of the Golden Triangle.
